verdict.rationale: Rive documents an official MCP server connecting the Editor to AI tools, letting agents create/modify View Models (variable-like data), State Machines, Layouts, and Components (rive-docs-19, rive-docs-27, rive-docs-10, rive-docs-11). This covers some 'design context' elements (component mappings, variables via view models) but is framed as agents building/editing Rive content rather than pulling existing frames or screenshots for implementation elsewhere. Missing for 10: explicit screenshot/frame extraction capability, evidence of pulling existing design context (vs. generating new), and independent/hands-on confirmation of the MCP workflow.
